meta.landingTitle: Meewind — Road cycling with the wind, not against it
meta.landingDescription: Meewind plans wind-optimized road cycling routes across the Netherlands: node-network routes, destination suggestions, curated signature routes, and GPX export for Garmin & Strava.
meta.plannerDescription: Pick a start point, set your distance, and plan a wind-optimized route along the Dutch cycle node network.

hero.kicker: WITH THE WIND, NOT AGAINST IT
hero.headline: RIDE WITH THE WIND. NOT AGAINST IT.
hero.sub: Meewind plans your road cycling route across the Netherlands so the wind pushes you instead of slowing you down — plus node-network routes, destination suggestions, curated signature routes, and GPX export for Garmin & Strava.
hero.photoAlt: Cyclists on a historic street in Groningen at golden hour

windMoment.headline: WIND-OPTIMIZED. ALWAYS.
windMoment.body: Meewind pulls real wind forecasts for your ride day and calculates every route in both directions. Whichever direction gets more tailwind in the harder second third of the ride is the one you ride — automatically, not as a checkbox buried in settings.
windMoment.example: Example: wind from the west at 24 km/h — the route is ridden counter-clockwise so the way back gets tailwind instead of a headwind.

items.title: NODE-NETWORK ROUTES
items.body: Loop rides along the Dutch cycle node network (fietsknooppunten) — pick a start point and distance, Meewind links the nodes into a full loop.
items.photoAlt: Paved cycle path through a pine forest

items.title: DESTINATION SUGGESTIONS
items.body: No fixed destination? Meewind suggests worthwhile places within your target distance — with a preview route and an optional train ride home.

items.title: SIGNATURE ROUTES
items.body: 19 curated routes across the country, from the Amstelroute to the Amstel Gold Race Loop in Zuid-Limburg — well-known tours, re-planned for wind and your priorities.
items.photoAlt: Dutch village street with flags hung outside houses

items.title: GPX EXPORT
items.body: Every planned route as a GPX file for Garmin, Strava, and Komoot — including cafés, fuel stations, and ice cream stops along the way.
items.photoAlt: Tulip field under a blue sky

signup.headline: READY FOR A TAILWIND?
signup.body: Plan a route, let the wind forecast settle, ride.

footer.tagline: Wind-optimized road cycling routes across the Netherlands.
